Fastest GPT Image 2.5 variant for everyday generation. Quality settings: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, auto. Image cached input is $2.00/1M (0.000002 per token); text output is not billed. Token rates match gpt-image-2. No batch pricing published for this model. Rate limits are tier-based (Tier 1: 100k TPM / 5 IPM, Tier 5: 8M TPM / 250 IPM); Free tier not supported. Released 2026-09-08.
